Thanks Naomi — quick notes from infra ops:

- Load test profile: asking for the customer's target — 100 requests over ~5 minutes is fine; we'll throttle if we see any queueing. We should also set an automatic fallback policy to a cheaper variant if latency rises above SLO.
- AV & recording: I've looped in campus AV (av-support@redwood.com). They asked for a visitor-instructions.docx that we can forward to the security desk and BlueBank.

Ben — can you confirm you have the prompt set and a test harness (Postman/Jenkins job) to run the warmup and the burst? If not, I can provision a short-lived test harness.
